explanation: This slide presents a visual diagram showing the regulation of the trp operon in both its active state (in the absence of tryptophan) and inactive state (in the presence of tryptophan).

questions.q: Under what conditions are the structural genes of the trp operon transcribed?
opts: When tryptophan is abundant in the cell.
When tryptophan is absent or in low concentration.
Only in the presence of lactose.
When the repressor is bound to the operator.
questions.exp: Option B is correct because the trp operon is a repressible operon that remains 'on' (active) to synthesize tryptophan when tryptophan is absent. When tryptophan is present (Option A) or the repressor binds (Option D), transcription is blocked. Option C is unrelated.
